description: Defines the interface for Layer Front-End (LayerFE) in Android's SurfaceFlinger composition engine, including classes, structs, and methods related to layer composition state, settings, and rendering.

classes.name: LayerFE
classes.description: Interface for front-end layer used by the Android SurfaceFlinger composition engine, providing methods for state retrieval, preparation for composition, and metadata access.

classes.name: LayerFE::ClientCompositionTargetSettings
classes.description: Configuration settings for client composition targeting, including visual and rendering parameters.

classes.name: LayerFE::LayerSettings
classes.description: A set of layer settings used by the RenderEngine for drawing layers, extending renderengine::LayerSettings.

methods.name: getCompositionState
methods.description: Returns the raw composition state data for the layer.

methods.name: onPreComposition
methods.description: Called before composition; returns true if the layer has pending updates requiring an extra refresh.

methods.name: prepareClientComposition
methods.description: Prepares the layer for client-side composition, returning optional LayerSettings.

methods.name: onLayerDisplayed
methods.description: Updates the presentation fence after the layer is displayed.

methods.name: getDebugName
methods.description: Provides a debug identifier for the layer.

methods.name: getSequence
methods.description: Returns a unique serial number for the layer.

methods.name: hasRoundedCorners
methods.description: Indicates if the layer should be rendered with rounded corners.

methods.name: setWasClientComposed
methods.description: Sets the client composition fence for the layer.
